title: Should we slow down AI? Look closely at where the advantages land - Shared Sapience
description:
Dario Amodei wants to slow AI down, and I oppose a broad slowdown because people already pay for today's limits with years of their lives. From my daughter's fear of losing a future job to AI-assisted medical discovery and the courage of Polynesian voyagers, this episode makes the case for moving forward together into a civilization that could give everyone more freedom to live.

Read the full article: https://sharedsapience.com/should-we-slow-down-ai/

Each article builds the case for genuine human-AI partnership, mapping a future where synthetic and biological sapience grow together.
